content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Work evaluates column-store systems against PostgreSQL for sequential range scan performance on large audit datasets, achieving latency improvements of 4.2 to 7.8 times through storage engine optimization.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01218","field":"abstract","quote":"Range scan latency for twelve-month compliance report queries improved by factors of 4.2 to 7.8"}]},{"text":"Research on PostgreSQL streaming replication configurations for asynchronous log servers demonstrates that offloading write-intensive operations to dedicated servers can reduce transaction latency overhead to below 4 percent at throughput above 400 transactions per second.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01215","field":"abstract","quote":"the dedicated log server approach keeps latency overhead below 4 percent at the same throughput level"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher's publications address PostgreSQL performance optimization and distributed log architectures [SYN-PUB-01215, SYN-PUB-01218], which overlap with query routing and caching strategies, but focus primarily on append-only audit logs rather than general transactional query optimization under peak load constraints."}
